reports.title: Zeta Global Reports 21st Consecutive “Beat and Raise” Quarter, Generates Positive GAAP Net Income in 3Q’26 & YTD, and Achieves the Rule of 71

lines: Increasing full year 2026 revenue guidance by $37 million to $1,855 million at the midpoint, up from prior guidance of $1,818 million, reflecting Y/Y growth of 42%.
Increasing full year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to $0.23 at the midpoint, up $0.20 or over 600% from our initial guidance of $0.03.
Increasing full year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to a range of $0.22 to $0.24, up $0.13 at the midpoint from prior guidance of $0.09 to $0.11.

desk.headline: Revenue up 46% to $493m, beat; full-year revenue, profit and cash outlook raised
results: Revenue rose 46% to $493m; stripping out the Marigold deal and political ads, growth was 30%, faster than Q2.
Zeta made a GAAP profit of $38.3m ($0.14 a share) versus a small loss a year ago; adjusted EPS was $0.38.
Adjusted EBITDA rose to $121m and the margin widened to 24.6% from 23.2%.
Free cash flow grew 73% to $81.5m; operating cash flow was $91.3m.
Customers paying at least $1m a year rose 18% to 212, and average revenue from them grew 22% to $2.0m.

guidance.summary: Zeta raised its Q4 and full-year 2026 outlook for revenue, adjusted EBITDA, free cash flow and GAAP EPS. The EPS guide excludes a possible one-off tax gain.

points: Use of its Athena AI tool is spreading: over half of the largest customers now use it monthly, up from just over 40% in Q2.
The AthenaOS product moves to customer testing this year, with general release expected in Q1 2027.
Management repeated an organic growth model of "at least 20%"; formal 2027 guidance comes in February.
Partnerships with Palantir and OpenAI were highlighted, though management said they are not yet material to revenue.
Q4 political ad revenue is now seen at about $13m; stock-based pay fell to 12% of revenue so far this year.
call.source: Call transcript: The Motley Fool, 10 Nov 2026

watch: The 2027 outlook due in February and how much organic growth it implies.
Uptake of AthenaOS after its planned Q1 2027 general release.
Whether the possible one-off tax gain from releasing the valuation allowance is booked.
